name: Qualys SSL Labs (SSL Server Test pages)
tier_rationale: Established security company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P290 cond 5: 'trusted - SSL Labs (Qualys)'.

reliability.justification: TLS configuration assessment run by SSL Labs against the target.

report_pages.title: SSL Server Test report analyze.html?d={domain}&hideResults=on&latest (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

report_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P290 cond 1). Research C0652 terms 'Qualys terms'. The template always carries hideResults=on&latest (results kept off the public 'recently seen' board, so publishes=false; P290 cond 9). On a cache miss opening it starts a new third-party TLS assessment of the target: touches_target=true, flag fetches_target. Used by pivots_pentest (pack pentest.json). The SSL Labs API (api.ssllabs.com) is not used here: a package that adds it extends this provider.

notes: Manual pivot links only (batch p2-G14-2): V3LUM never fetches them (P311). fetches_target: opening the report may make SSL Labs assess the target live.
